name: indus-erp
description: Indus ERP monorepo: admin web dashboard, vendor Android app, API, and shared packages.

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared-types -w packages/config -w packages/auth -w packages/db -w services/api -w apps/admin-web -w apps/vendor-mobile --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w packages/shared-types -w packages/config -w packages/auth -w packages/db --if-present && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
